name: MonarchTextField
title: Input
summary: A labelled text field with placeholder, helper text, an error state, a required mark, read-only and multiline modes, accessories and a focus binding, over the standard TextField or SecureField.
whenToUse: For text input in a Monarch layout: single line, or multiline with axis: .vertical. Use labelVisibility: .hidden inside a Form row whose label already names the field.
whenNotToUse: For long documents with formatting use MonarchRichTextEditor (iOS 26 and later). For numbers use MonarchNumberInput.
api: init(_ label: String, text: Binding<String>, prompt: String? = nil, helper: String? = nil, error: String? = nil, isSecure: Bool = false, isRequired: Bool = false, isReadOnly: Bool = false, axis: Axis = .horizontal, lineLimit: ClosedRange<Int>? = nil, labelVisibility: Visibility = .visible, focus: FocusState<Bool>.Binding? = nil, labels: MonarchFormFieldLabels = MonarchFormFieldLabels())

init<Leading: View, Trailing: View>(_ label: String, text: Binding<String>, prompt: String? = nil, helper: String? = nil, error: String? = nil, isSecure: Bool = false, isRequired: Bool = false, isReadOnly: Bool = false, axis: Axis = .horizontal, lineLimit: ClosedRange<Int>? = nil, labelVisibility: Visibility = .visible, focus: FocusState<Bool>.Binding? = nil, labels: MonarchFormFieldLabels = MonarchFormFieldLabels(), @ViewBuilder leading: () -> Leading, @ViewBuilder trailing: () -> Trailing)

options.name: prompt
options.description: Placeholder shown while the field is empty.

options.name: error
options.description: Error message; replaces the helper while present.

options.name: isRequired
options.description: Shows a mark after the label and adds "Required" to the hint.

options.name: isReadOnly
options.description: Shows the text, selectable, without letting it be edited; "Read only" is added to the hint.

options.name: axis
options.description: .vertical for a multiline field that grows with its text.

options.name: lineLimit
options.description: The fewest and most lines of a multiline field; nil grows without a limit.

options.name: labelVisibility
options.description: .hidden draws no label, for a Form row. The label is still the spoken name.

options.name: focus
options.description: The app's focus binding for the field.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the spoken "Required", "Read only" and the form of an error.

options.name: leading / trailing
options.description: Views inside the field box before and after the text, such as a currency symbol or a clear button.

states.name: empty
states.description: Shows the prompt in the subtle text colour.

states.name: focused
states.description: Draws the theme's focus ring around the field.

states.name: error
states.description: Danger border, and an icon and message under the field.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Subtle background and the disabled text colour, set with disabled(_:).

appearance: A surface-coloured field with an input border and 8-point corners. The focus ring is 2 points wide in the accent, or 3 points in the text colour in the high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: Android wraps Material 3 OutlinedTextField with a floating label; iOS keeps the label above the field, as iOS forms do. There is no MonarchTextFieldStyle, because SwiftUI's TextFieldStyle has no public requirement to implement. Keyboard type, content type and submit label are the standard SwiftUI modifiers.
accessibility: The field is one VoiceOver element: label, then value, then the error (spoken as "Error: …") or else the helper text as the hint.
A new error message is announced when it appears.
The error is shown with an icon and text, not colour alone.
The field is at least 44 points high and the whole field focuses the input when touched.
edgeCases: An empty error string counts as no error.
The built-in "Error:" prefix cannot be replaced by a parameter.

examples.title: Sizes and states
examples.template:
VStack(spacing: MonarchTokens.Space.space3) {
    MonarchTextField("Small", text: $small, prompt: {{small}}, labelVisibility: .hidden)
    MonarchTextField("Default", text: $standard, prompt: {{default}}, labelVisibility: .hidden)
    MonarchTextField("Large", text: $large, prompt: {{large}}, labelVisibility: .hidden)
    MonarchTextField("Invalid", text: $invalid, labelVisibility: .hidden)
        // The invalid field has the danger border, as on the web; an `error` message would add a line under it.
        .overlay(
            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: MonarchTokens.Radius.md, style: .continuous)
                .strokeBorder(theme.colors.dangerSolid, lineWidth: 1)
        )
    MonarchTextField("Disabled", text: $disabled, prompt: {{disabled}}, labelVisibility: .hidden)
        .disabled(true)
    MonarchTextField("Notes", text: $notes, prompt: {{notes}}, axis: .vertical, lineLimit: 3...6, labelVisibility: .hidden)
}

parityExceptions.reason: The web shows three heights (small, default, large) and an invalid field with a red border and no message. A native field keeps one height of at least 44 pt, and an error always carries its message with an icon so it is not told by colour alone.
parityExceptions.convention: HIG: Text fields, 44 pt targets; Accessibility, do not rely on colour alone
